assertion.text: Erdős Problem #1057: declared status 'open'. Formalized: no. Let $C(x)$ count the number of Carmichael numbers in the interval $[1,x]$. Is it true that $C(x)=x^{1-o(1)}$? Current best: The best-known lower bound to date is\[C(x)> x^{0.33336704},\]due to Harman \cite{Ha08}. Prize: no. OEIS: A006931. Tags: number theory.
